scope: Real finite-height 3D fundamental quasi-TE two-port modal coefficients from four local electromagnetic solves; no commercial agreement or general convergence certification.
final_guard_provenance: The recorded actual runs precede an added per-frequency Ey polarization rejection/metadata guard. Every retained raw local mode was audited with that final guard and passed. Numerical source/evolution/projection code and saved coefficients are unchanged.
runtime: FDTDX0.6.2/JAX0.10.2 on existing WSL CPU/CUDA environments. Source/mode eigensolves use local CPU Tidy3D2.11.2; requested device performs the FDTD evolution. No remote solver or account.
method: Independent per-frequency local numerical modes; reciprocal complex E/H overlap, common center-Ey phase gauge, explicit Yee spatial and H temporal co-location. Reference incident normalization and coherent reflected-field subtraction; no phase/amplitude fitting or forced unit through.

ports.phase_convention: DFT exp(+i omega t), physical exp(-i omega t), forward exp(+i beta x)
ports.mode_gauge: Ey at the center sample is real and positive; common +x basis at both ports
ports.normalization: Unit-power reciprocal E/H modal projection divided by separately measured incident coefficient; reflection reference subtracted; transmission propagation phase retained

mode.gauge: Ey at the center sample is real and positive; common +x basis at both ports

normalization.definition: S[frequency,output_port,input_port] = outgoing unit-power modal amplitude / separately measured incoming reference amplitude
normalization.reflection: Complex reference backward amplitude is subtracted before incident normalization
normalization.transmission: Actual device output / reference input; straight-guide propagation phase retained, no through correction or deembedding
normalization.projection: a+/-=[integral(E_sim cross H_mode* +/- E_mode* cross H_sim).x dA]/(4 sqrt(P_mode)); P_mode=.5 Re integral(E_mode cross H_mode*).x dA
normalization.phase_convention: DFT sum(field(t)*exp(+i omega t)); physical exp(-i omega t); forward propagation exp(+i beta x)
normalization.mode_gauge: Ey at the center sample is real and positive; common +x basis at both ports
normalization.sampling: Both mode profiles and measured E/H use Ez Yee-point spatial interpolation; H includes adjacent-time average cos(omega*dt/2)

cases.material_sampling: Ex uses voxel permittivity; Ey/Ez use adjacent-x-cell arithmetic average to place tangential gap interfaces at their actual Yee x locations. epsilon_components retains these actual coefficients cropped to the display grid (not spatially averaged with fields); raw_permittivity_components preserves all3component Yee coefficients. No transverse or general3D subpixel averaging.

geometry_translation.convention: Dimensions rounded to cells; centered lower indices floored; source/port planes rounded to grid coordinates

hidden_gpu_check.observed: CUDA_ERROR_NO_DEVICE; explicit requested GPU initialization failed and CPU fallback was disabled; no electromagnetic stage started.

pure_tests.scope: Complex forward/backward superposition, phase-preserving subtraction, mode scale, Yee interpolation, source eigenvector gauge, material-interface mirror symmetry per-frequency physical quasi-TE polarization and invalid basis rejection. Synthetic math tests are not solver accuracy evidence.

limitations: Fundamental-mode submatrix, not a complete radiation/higher-mode scattering basis. Modal missing power is not absorption.
Source profile is solved at pulse center and reused across the band; measured reference launch fractions are recorded, not assumed perfectly pure.
The x-interface correction is bounded to the supported straight/gap geometry. Transverse interfaces remain voxelized; this is not a general3D subpixel method.
Default mesh has measurable phase error. Resolution24 exceeds the interactive1.2million-cell bound and is recorded as a direct adapter diagnostic.
CPU/GPU consistency, reciprocity, mirror checks and settling do not establish external accuracy. Timing observations include concurrent local validation work.
Short-cap and strict temporal diagnostics intentionally bypass GUI limits; their actual configurations and invalid flags are retained.

reference_plane_diagnostic.note: Actual matrices retain their different physical-plane phases. The following comparison alone divides by separately measured straight-reference propagation factors; it does not modify saved results.

development_failures_and_corrections.issue: Native0.6.2 ModePlaneSource discarded the arbitrary imaginary reverse-mode eigenvector gauge with real(E/H), producing zero source energy.
development_failures_and_corrections.observation: Actual reverse reference stage failed the nonzero-energy guard.
development_failures_and_corrections.correction: Adapter fixes the center-Ey eigenvector phase before taking the real TFSF profile, preserving physical direction and native offsets. No installed package was patched.

development_failures_and_corrections.issue: Scalar voxel material broadcast onto all Yee E components shifted tangential gap interfaces by half a cell relative to longitudinal Ex.
development_failures_and_corrections.correction: Actual evolution uses Ex voxel epsilon and adjacent-x-cell arithmetic-average tangential Ey/Ez epsilon at their physical positions. Components are exported; no output phase fitting.

reproduction.supported: Write an exact supported case config to a JSON file and run .venv/bin/python scripts/run_simulation.py CONFIG.json --output NEW_DIRECTORY after configuring the recorded solver environment.
reproduction.direct_diagnostics: For cases outside GUI validation, use a fresh configured FDTDX interpreter and call backend.adapters.fdtdx_ports3d_adapter.run(config, Path(NEW_DIRECTORY)). Those cases are not advertised as selectable GUI studies.
reproduction.artifacts: Actual raw arrays and per-stage phasors are retained locally; GUI result/reproduction ZIPs include them for completed jobs. Hashes above identify the qualification artifacts.
